_comment: Canned Claude output for --fake-llm. Batch k gets the slice starting at k * batch size, wrapping with ' II' name suffixes. The first 20 cover every type, kind, effect (shockwave included), hit_joint and power plus invalid specs (bad enum, prop, bad prompt start, bad power, duplicate name, taken aliases) and fixable ones (old effect tag, power as a string, duration out of range). Later ones add more drops and fixes, including Kimodo style subjects (one with the wrong article and a trailing period) and a decimal inside a prompt. The last three use motion words that look like props or banned words but are fine (shields, rocks, balls of the feet, axe kick, explosively) and two hit_joint sides that the validator flips.
